# Import regression fixtures

- `pbr322.gbk` and `pbr322.gff` are complete, unmodified Prokka 1.14.6 outputs
  from ENA J01749.1, generated with `--addgenes --plasmid pBR322` on 21 October 2026.
- `tn21-reference.gbk` is the ENA AF071413.3 deposited annotation, converted
  from EMBL to GenBank using Biopython 1.88. No feature annotations were added.

See [the validation report](../../../analysis/prokka-validation/README.md) for
source URLs, checksums, the pinned Docker image and reproduction commands.
